plain: To clear of blame or prove to be right

webster.text: To defend; to justify; to support or maintain as true or correct, against denial, censure or objections.

more.text: To assert; to defend with success; to maintain; to prove to be just or valid; as, to vindicate a claim or title.
To defend with arms, or otherwise; as, to vindicate our rights.

example.quote: It belongs to us to vindicate the honor of the human race, and to teach that assuming brother, moderation.
